cw-9ndl.title: Plants: cacti by the road
cw-9ndl.summary: The semi-arid climate means cacti are commonly seen.

cw-C1Qn.title: Sign: blue street sign on yellow post
cw-C1Qn.summary: Blue street name signs mounted on top of yellow signposts are common.

cw-DdrH.title: Guardrail: yellow and blue on a wide bridge
cw-DdrH.summary: A wide four-lane bridge with yellow and blue guardrails and a view over a city.

cw-IcNc.title: Plate: square, looks plain white when blurred
cw-IcNc.summary: Square licence plates that look completely white through the blur. Front plates are mandatory, but a minority of cars have none.

cw-Nchv.title: Google car: black with a roof rack
cw-Nchv.summary: A black Street View car with a roof rack. Only this island has a black car like this.

cw-SRsK.title: Landscape: dry green hills, narrow roads
cw-SRsK.summary: In the west: semi-arid countryside with green but dry hills, spread-out houses and quite narrow roads.

cw-YPX7.title: Traffic lights: black-and-white striped posts
cw-YPX7.summary: In towns the traffic light posts are striped black and white.

cw-aKGZ.title: Coverage: stick in front of the lens
cw-aKGZ.summary: In the centre of the island, the camera has a stick poking in front of the lens.

cw-hvDX.title: Territory: counts as the Netherlands
cw-hvDX.summary: A Caribbean island north of Venezuela, part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands. For country streaks it counts as the Netherlands.

cw-lm-315.title: Google car: black, roof rack, white stickers
cw-lm-315.summary: A black car with a roof rack and a white sticker on the front left and back right of the rack. Only this island has it.

cw-nT9Q.title: Houses: pastel one-storey bungalows
cw-nT9Q.summary: Simple one-storey bungalows in pastel colours. Small shacks have metal roofs, pricier houses have tiled roofs, and multi-storey villas appear sometimes.

cw-wuzk.title: Pole: three alternating insulators on wood
cw-wuzk.summary: Wooden poles whose top has three horizontal insulators placed alternately. The same poletop exists in Brazil, South Africa and Eswatini.

cw-zAfQ.title: Sign: coloured border continues on the back
cw-zAfQ.summary: The coloured border on road signs usually carries onto the back of the sign, generally red or blue.

cw-zB68.title: Coverage: wind farm in rainy weather
cw-zB68.summary: A line of wind turbines in the southeast, with notably rainy coverage.
